g.text: The base is today's geometry: the island's outline, today's boroughs and towns,

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #52514e

g.text: and a few long-standing streets, named on the first panel. The built-up

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #52514e

g.text: area of each era is not shown. Old street names were matched by hand

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #52514e
font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #52514e
font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #52514e

g.text: A press record, not a count of all deaths. Counts, not risk.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #52514e
font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #52514e

g.text: The west of the island, where no located death falls, is outside the frame.

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Truck or other heavy motor vehicle

g.text: Crossing of two streets, a civic number, or within about a block

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Only the street is known: the mark sits at the middle of it

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Helvetica'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Where the newspapers place the deaths of cyclists under 15, island of Montréal, by era

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: 63 of the 69 deaths in the press record have a place that can be put on a map; one mark each. Colour and shape: the other party, as on the timeline.
